items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Turns Creative Cloud And Firefly Into AI Studios With New Partnerships
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS: ADBE) announced major AI product rollouts that turn Creative Cloud and Firefly into fully AI-powered studios. The company introduced agentic AI tools across its creative platforms, aiming to automate complex design and content workflows for users. Adobe expanded its AI partnerships with Google and Microsoft, integrating its creative technologies with widely used productivity and cloud platforms.
